title: Connect* needs stories
body:
**Feature: What is your use case for such a feature?**

using connect as a feature isn’t very easy, because the only example is a connectSearchBox.

**Feature: What is your proposed API entry? The new option to add? What is the behavior?**

adding stories or other examples about each of the connectors would be very useful in understanding how they work, and how you “should” use them.

**What project are you opening an issue for?**

* react-instantsearch
